# UnrealMCP — Command Reference

**302 tools** (generated by `scripts/gen_command_manifest.py` — do not edit by hand).

| Tool | Module | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `add_blueprint_node` | blueprint_graph | Add a node to a Blueprint graph. |
| `add_component_to_blueprint` | blueprints | Add a component to a Blueprint's default components. |
| `add_custom_event_node` | blueprint_graph | Add a custom event node, optionally with parameters. |
| `add_data_table_row` | data_tables | Add a new row, optionally setting initial field values. |
| `add_delegate_node` | blueprint_graph | Add a multicast-delegate node (Bind/Unbind/Call/Assign). |
| `add_event_node` | blueprint_graph | Add an event override node to the event graph. |
| `add_function_input` | blueprint_graph | Add an input parameter to a Blueprint function. |
| `add_function_output` | blueprint_graph | Add an output parameter to a Blueprint function. |
| `add_input_action_modifier` | enhanced_input | Add a modifier to an Input Action. |
| `add_input_action_trigger` | enhanced_input | Add a trigger to an Input Action. |
| `add_key_mapping` | enhanced_input | Add a key-to-action mapping to an Input Mapping Context. |
| `add_mapping_modifier` | enhanced_input | Add a modifier to a specific mapping in an Input Mapping Context. |
| `add_mapping_trigger` | enhanced_input | Add a trigger to a specific mapping in an Input Mapping Context. |
| `add_mass_config_trait` | data_assets | Add a SINGLE trait to a Mass Entity Config without replacing existing traits. |
| `add_material_comments` | materials | Add comment boxes to a material graph for organization. |

| `add_niagara_emitter` | niagara | Add an emitter to a Niagara System. |
| `add_niagara_event_handler` | niagara | Add an event handler to an emitter that responds to events from a source emitter. |
| `add_niagara_graph_node` | niagara | Create a new node inside a Niagara scratch-pad / dynamic-input / module graph. |
| `add_niagara_map_get_pin` | niagara | Add a typed output pin to the first ParameterMapGet node in a scratch pad graph. |
| `add_niagara_map_set_pin` | niagara | Add a typed input pin to the first ParameterMapSet node in a scratch pad graph. |
| `add_niagara_module` | niagara | Add a module to an emitter's script usage stack. |

| `add_niagara_renderer` | niagara | Add a renderer to an emitter. |
| `add_niagara_script_parameter` | niagara | Add an input or output parameter to a Niagara script. |
| `add_niagara_simulation_stage` | niagara | Add a simulation stage to an emitter. |
| `add_niagara_user_parameter` | niagara | Add a user parameter to a Niagara System. Supports every type the editor's |
| `add_parent_call_node` | blueprint_graph | Add a "Call to Parent Function" node (e.g. Parent: BeginPlay). |
| `add_statetree_binding` | statetree | Add a property binding connecting a source node's output to a target node's input. |
| `add_statetree_condition` | statetree | Add a condition to a state's enter conditions or a transition's conditions. |
| `add_statetree_evaluator` | statetree | Add a global evaluator to the StateTree. |

| `set_niagara_user_parameter` | niagara | Set a user parameter value on a Niagara System asset or level actor instance. |
| `set_physics_properties` | editor_commands | Set physics properties on a Blueprint component. |
| `set_slot_properties` | widgets | Set layout slot properties (anchors, offsets, padding, alignment, etc.). |
| `set_statetree_color` | statetree | Add or update a color in the StateTree theme. |
| `set_statetree_node_property` | statetree | Set a property on a task, evaluator, or condition by GUID. |
| `set_statetree_schema` | statetree | Change the schema of a StateTree. Warning: existing nodes may become invalid. |
| `set_statetree_state_property` | statetree | Set a property on a state (Name, Type, SelectionBehavior, Enabled, Tag, Weight, etc.). |
| `set_statetree_transition_property` | statetree | Set a property on a transition (Trigger, Priority, TargetState, Delay, Enabled, etc.). |
| `set_static_mesh_properties` | editor_commands | Set the static mesh on a StaticMeshComponent in a Blueprint. |
| `set_viewport_camera` | editor_commands | Place the level viewport camera exactly. |
| `set_widget_properties` | widgets | Set multiple widget properties. Same format as set_data_asset_properties. |
| `spawn_actor` | level | Spawn an actor in the current editor level. |
| `spawn_actor_by_class` | level | Spawn ANY AActor subclass by full path, short name, or Blueprint asset path. |
| `spawn_blueprint_actor` | editor_commands | Spawn a Blueprint actor instance in the level. |
| `spawn_mesh_actor` | editor_commands | Spawn a named actor with an optional static mesh + scale. |
| `spawn_niagara_effect` | niagara | Spawn a Niagara System as an actor in the level. |
| `start_pie` | editor_commands | Start a Play-In-Editor session (async — starts on the next editor tick). |
| `stop_pie` | editor_commands | End the current Play-In-Editor session (async — ends on the next tick). |
| `sync_browser` | assets | Navigate the Content Browser to show a specific asset. |
| `take_screenshot` | editor_commands | Capture the editor to a PNG. |
| `trace_blueprint_graph` | blueprint_graph | Trace the execution path through a Blueprint graph. |
| `trace_material_connection` | materials | Trace connections upstream and/or downstream from a specific node. |
| `trace_niagara_connection` | niagara | Breadth-first trace of connections from a starting node through the graph. |
| `update_data_table_row` | data_tables | Update specific fields on an existing row (partial update). |
| `validate_material_function` | materials | Diagnose issues in a Material Function's internal graph. |
| `validate_material_graph` | materials | Diagnose connection issues in a material graph. |
| `validate_niagara_graph` | niagara | Classify orphaned, dead-end, and missing-input nodes in a Niagara graph. |
| `wait_until_ready` | core | Block until the editor is up AND ready for commands, or time out. |
